title: La vida cotidiana
goal: Read how colonial cities were designed by royal law, how the plaza became their social centre, and how class showed in housing.

items: Explain why so many colonial cities share the same layout.
Describe the contrast between stone mansions and adobe dwellings on the edge of the city.
Name the buildings placed around the Plaza Mayor.
Explain what made the plaza the real social center of a colonial city.
Use 'a lo largo de', 'a raíz de' and 'como consecuencia de' to order and explain daily events.
